data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Minerva's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in NODK, ECBK, and CPBI.

On September 23, 2026, CPBI disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1979332/000094337426000419/cpbi-20260922.htm).

I publish independent, public-records-only research at Local Ledger. May I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
